title: Tee'Crown's Community Engagement in Makoko
author: Tee'Crown Consult
excerpt: A structured community visit to Makoko — using responsible tourism as a platform for measurable social impact.
body:
Tee'Crown Consult facilitated a structured community engagement visit to Makoko, the waterfront settlement located along the Lagos Lagoon. The visit was designed around responsible tourism principles.

Rather than treating the community as a backdrop, the engagement centred on listening, learning and contributing — using tourism as a platform for measurable social impact.

We believe travel should benefit the communities that host it. Experiences like Makoko reflect our commitment to sustainability and cultural appreciation.

It is a small part of a larger promise: to preserve the uniquely rich heritage of Nigeria for generations to come.
